_comment: Copy to .mcp.json in the repo you want to USE the server from (Claude Code, Cursor), or to ~/.gemini/config/mcp_config.json for Antigravity — the same shape works for all of them. Build the server first with 'mix setup && MIX_ENV=prod mix release', then edit 'command' and the two values marked <…>. PROJECT_ROOT is the repo you are editing, not the clone; pointing it at the clone answers confidently about the wrong versions. MCP_TRANSPORT is required and has no default. DATABASE_PATH is deliberately absent: it defaults to <clone>/priv/mcp.db, which is what 'mix setup' migrates.
